calibration_sources: AMD Instinct MI300X CDNA3 Architecture Whitepaper (8 XCD Chiplets, 256MB Infinity Cache, 192GB 5.3TB/s HBM3, Wavefront-64 MFMA)
AMD AITER (AI Tensor Engine for ROCm) & OpenAI Triton / TileLang Cross-Vendor Autotuning Benchmarks
Mooncake / vLLM Disaggregated Serving over Standard RoCEv2 RDMA Across Heterogeneous Prefill & Decode Pools

workload.cluster_profile: Heterogeneous Fleet: 8×NVIDIA H100-80GB (3.35 TB/s HBM3, $28.80/hr) + 8×AMD Instinct MI300X-192GB (5.30 TB/s HBM3, $21.60/hr)
workload.model_profile: Llama-3.3-70B-FP8 / DeepSeek-R1-Distill-70B (80 Layers, TP=8, 32K Long-Context Sessions)
workload.architectural_contrast: NVIDIA Hopper (32-thread Warp, 132 SMs, TMA/wgmma, 80GB) vs AMD CDNA3 MI300X (64-thread Wavefront, 8 XCD Chiplets, 304 CUs, MFMA, 192GB)

tiers.name: Tier 1: 朴素 HIPIFY 源码硬转 (照搬 CUDA Warp-32 分块 + 无 8-XCD 缓存亲和)
tiers.name_en: Tier 1: Naive HIPIFY Source Port (Unchanged Warp-32 Tile Geometry + 8-XCD L2 Thrashing)
tiers.compiler_and_kernel_stack: Automated hipify-perl C++ translation without Wavefront-64 retuning or XCD chiplet swizzling
tiers.deployment_topology: Monolithic Mixed Prefill+Decode on MI300X (Frequent Cross-XCD Mall Cache Misses)
tiers.recommended_for: Initial compilation smoke tests only; never use in production because CUDA 32-thread warp assumptions waste 50% of CDNA3 64-thread wavefront lanes and thrash across 8 XCD chiplets.

tiers.name: Tier 2: 静态 ONNX / OpenXLA 跨芯片图导出 (丢失 PagedAttention 与融合 MoE 算子)
tiers.name_en: Tier 2: Static ONNX / OpenXLA Graph Export (Loses Custom Paged KV & Fused MoE Kernels)
tiers.compiler_and_kernel_stack: Exports model to static ONNX/XLA IR; falls back to generic GEMM/Attention primitives
tiers.deployment_topology: Monolithic Serving with Padded Static KV Tensors
tiers.recommended_for: Small fixed-shape BERT/ResNet encoder models; unsuitable for modern LLMs due to lack of block-paged KV caching, EAGLE-3 speculative trees, and FP8 grouped MoE kernels.

tiers.name: Tier 3: 统一 Triton / TileLang + AMD AITER 架构感知调优 (Wave64 + 8-XCD L2 亲和)
tiers.name_en: Tier 3: Unified OpenAI Triton / TileLang + AMD AITER (Wavefront-64 + 8-XCD L2 Swizzling)
tiers.compiler_and_kernel_stack: Hardware-agnostic Python DSL (Triton/TileLang) autotuned per target (waves_per_eu, matrix_instr_nonkdim=16) + AMD AITER assembly FlashAttention/MoE
tiers.recommended_for: Single-vendor AMD MI300X/MI325X clusters running unified vLLM/SGLang with 100% codebase parity and 2.54x higher throughput than naive HIPIFY.

tiers.name: Tier 4: 跨架构异构 PD 分离 (H100 算力池跑 Prefill + MI300X 192GB 5.3TB/s 显存池跑 Decode)
tiers.name_en: Tier 4: Cross-Vendor Heterogeneous PD Disaggregation (H100 Prefill + MI300X 192GB Decode via Mooncake RoCEv2)
tiers.compiler_and_kernel_stack: H100 runs FA3/Cutlass FP8 Prefill; MI300X runs AITER/Triton Wave64 Paged Decode; Mooncake 400G RoCEv2 transfers raw FP8 KV blocks across vendors
tiers.deployment_topology: Compute-Bound Prefill on 80GB H100 + Bandwidth/Capacity-Bound Decode on 192GB MI300X (1.53 TB/node)
tiers.recommended_for: Multi-vendor enterprise AI centers combining NVIDIA & AMD GPUs—matching each silicon architecture to its physical roofline (H100 FLOPs for Prefill, MI300X 192GB/5.3TB/s for Decode).
